summary: In the subway station, a destroyed phone dangles in the empty booth. Neo turns to face Agent Smith, whose gun is aimed at him. Agent Smith addresses him by name: 'Mr. Anderson.'

what_changes.before: Facing away toward the empty booth where the destroyed phone dangles
what_changes.after: Confronted at gunpoint by Agent Smith
what_changes.evidence: Neo turns to Agent Smith whose gun stares at him like a third eye.

event_hint.one_line: Agent Smith corners Neo at gunpoint in the subway station, addressing him as Mr. Anderson.
